title: ICMR NIRRCH Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for Various Staff Nurse Posts
description: ICMR-National Institute for Research on Women's Health (ICMR-NIRRCH) has issued an official notification for the recruitment of 01 Staff Nurse Position. Candidates who have completed their GNM or ANM can grab this chance and apply for the ICMR NIRRCH Notification 2026 . Here we have included more details about the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
